title_line: Founder and Licensed Clinical Social Worker
bio_p1: Rachel is a therapist, founder, lifelong listener, and the original Patient Zero behind Pathways Within. She sets the vision, protects the culture, and keeps asking how Pathways can make care feel more connected, more human, and more useful in real life.
bio_p2: After losing her dad suddenly as a child, Rachel was raised by a village of aunts, uncles, grandparents, teachers, and friends. That village taught her the power of chosen family and the fact that wisdom can come from just about anywhere. She studied psychology, human behavior, and the mind body spirit connection, and built Pathways Within as the place she wished existed when she was finding her own way.
bullet_1: Specializes in anxiety and depression with a trauma informed lens
bullet_2: Works with couples using the Gottman Method and offers clinical hypnotherapy
